# DynamicVariant

`Flare.Components.DynamicVariant`

Dynamic-color scheme variant - how the source (seed) color is expanded into tonal roles.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TonalSpot` | `0` | Balanced palette close to the source hue (the default). |
| `Vibrant` | `1` | More saturated, punchier palette. |
| `Expressive` | `2` | Hue-shifted, playful palette. |
| `Neutral` | `3` | Low-chroma, muted palette. |
| `Monochrome` | `4` | Greyscale palette derived from the source's tone only. |
